scripts.test:contracts: pnpm test:near && pnpm test:evm && pnpm test:solana && pnpm test:sui && pnpm test:starknet
scripts.build:contracts: pnpm build:near && pnpm build:evm && pnpm build:solana && pnpm build:sui && pnpm build:starknet
scripts.build:coordinator: cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/near/Cargo.toml --locked --no-abi --out-dir contracts/near/target/near

scripts.check:solana: cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/solana/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path contracts/solana/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify:contracts: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm check:contracts && pnpm build:contracts && pnpm test:contracts && pnpm test:sandbox
